grounds: This is a real gap, but it predates session 2 and is out of session 2's scope, which is quote-provenance/PARSED_SUFFIXES deletion only. verify_worker_result never evaluated a check's condition/branch against a worker's declared result even when the check used AST (it only compared claimed vs measured absence-search counts and, before this session, matched ast_kind); nothing in the original design routed a worker's pass/fail claim through the check's own branch semantics. The critique pipeline is explicitly designed to decide nothing yet: test_critique_contracts.py:4 states 'The artifacts decide nothing yet,' and STATUS.md:110/117-119 records that the pipeline is off by default and nothing reads the check IR to make a decision. Building a condition/branch evaluator is a net-new feature -- exactly what set 143's own charter (every change in it is a deletion) and session 2's step list (spec.md Session 2 of 3) exclude. My remediation already removed the one place this session's own change could mislead a reader: the seeded fixture no longer records a pass when its own absence search finds the forbidden literal (test_critique_contracts.py now records result: fail for that case). A worker-result-vs-branch evaluator belongs to the step-execution/enforcement work in a later set (144/145), not to this deletion-only session.
